name: Automations
author: VanillaGreen
description: Runs shell commands on a recurrence through systemd user timers, with cron as the fallback, keeps each run's transcript for up to 30 days and notifies every failure. Manage automations in its window or with the plugin's bin/automations command.

historyDays.label: Keep history
historyDays.description: Days each run and its transcript are kept before they are pruned

requirements.purpose: Sends the notification of every failed run, and of each start and finish when asked
Installs, enables and removes each automation's systemd user timer
Starts Run now as a transient user service that outlives the shell
Checks each timer's calendar before it is written
Reads and turns on lingering, which runs timers while you are logged out
Schedules automations where no systemd user manager answers

scheduler.label: Scheduler
scheduler.hint: systemd user timers when a systemd user manager answers, else the crontab

linger.label: While logged out
linger.hint: User timers run while you are logged out only with lingering on

lastRuns.label: Last runs
lastRuns.hint: Automations whose last run failed; each failure also sends a notification whose click opens its transcript

problem.label: Engine
problem.hint: The last call of bin/automations that failed, the engine that owns the store, the timers and the history
